[ASSISTANT_SAID] b. Content Length: Aim for a minimum of 500 words per page.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] c. Content Freshness: Regularly update and add new content.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Mobile-Friendliness and Page Speed:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] a. Responsive Design: Ensure mobile-friendliness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] b. Page Speed: Optimize loading speed (target <3 seconds).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Internal Linking and Navigation:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] a. Clear Navigation: Organize website structure for easy navigation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] b. Internal Linking: Link to relevant pages within the website.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Image Optimization:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] a. Use Relevant File Names: Name images with descriptive, keyword-rich names.
